title: Heads-up side-check answer
description: Strict: codex --output-schema requires every property. none=true with empty strings means nothing worth raising.

none.description: True when nothing meets the bar: not specific, already raised, already known, or not worth an interruption.

tag.description: Empty when none is true. 'You should know' for a system, concept or design that matters for the person's work; 'Heads up' for this session's work: a decision the assistant made, something it did not highlight, a result that may be off.

topic.description: Empty when none is true. Otherwise a stable label under 140 characters, for de-duplication.

headline.description: Empty when none is true. Otherwise one sentence, about 20 words and under 200 characters, naming the actual thing and its consequence; no greeting, no name, no markdown.

detail.description: Empty when none is true. Otherwise under 600 characters, two or three plain sentences for someone who remembers nothing of the session: what the material shows, why it matters, and what to check or do next.
